002

004import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
005import java.util.LinkedHashSet;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Set;
008
009import org.apache.log4j.Logger;

011import com.fs.starfarer.api.EveryFrameScript;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignClockAPI;
014import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
015import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.listeners.AppliedPostCombatCRLossToPlayerFleetMemberListener;
016import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.OfficerDataAPI;

018import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;

020
021public class OfficerTracker implements EveryFrameScript, AppliedPostCombatCRLossToPlayerFleetMemberListener {
022        
023
024        public static class OfficerDeployments {
025                public OfficerDataAPI officer;
026                public FleetMemberAPI member;
027                public Long seenWithOfficer = null;
028                public Long seenWithoutOfficer = null;
029                public void resetTimes() {
030                        seenWithOfficer = null;
031                        seenWithoutOfficer = null;
032                }
033        }
034        
035        public static String HAS_REASSIGNMENT_COMPLAINT = "$hasReassignmentComplaint";
036        public static String REASSIGNMENT_SHIP_NAME = "$reassignedShipName";
037        
038        public static float MAX_DAYS_TO_KEEP_TRACK = 365;
039        public static String KEY = "$officerTracker_ref";
040        
041        public static Logger log = Logger.getLogger(OfficerTracker.class);
042        
043        protected IntervalUtil tracker = new IntervalUtil(0.1f, 0.2f);
044        protected LinkedHashMap<String, OfficerDeployments> data = new LinkedHashMap<>();
045        
046        public static OfficerTracker get() {
047                return (OfficerTracker) Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().get(KEY);
048        }
049        
050        public OfficerTracker() {
051                Global.getSector().getListenerManager().addListener(this);
052                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(KEY, this);
053        }
054
055        @Override
056        public void advance(float amount) {
057                //if (!Misc.isExtended()) return;
058                //if (!Misc.combatPayEnabled(officer))
059                
060                //if (true) return;
061                float days = Global.getSector().getClock().convertToDays(amount);
062                tracker.advance(days);
063                if (tracker.intervalElapsed()) {
064                        cleanUpOldData();
065                        
066                        CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
067                        List<FleetMemberAPI> membersCopy = pf.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
068                        for (FleetMemberAPI curr : membersCopy) {
069                                OfficerDataAPI od = getOfficerData(curr);
070                                if (od != null) {
071                                        applyFMStateToOfficerIfNecessary(curr, false);
072                                }
073                        }
074                }
075        }
076        
077        
078        @Override
079        public boolean isDone() {
080                return false;
081        }
082
083        @Override
084        public boolean runWhilePaused() {
085                return false;
086        }
087        
088        public void cleanUpOldData() {
089                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
090                if (pf == null) return;
091                CampaignClockAPI clock = Global.getSector().getClock();
092                
093                List<OfficerDataAPI> officersCopy = pf.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy();
094                List<FleetMemberAPI> membersCopy = pf.getFleetData().getMembersListCopy();
095
096                for (OfficerDeployments dep : new ArrayList<OfficerDeployments>(data.values())) {
097                        String id = dep.officer.getPerson().getId();
098                        
099                        boolean found = false;
100                        for (OfficerDataAPI od : officersCopy) {
101                                if (od.getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(HAS_REASSIGNMENT_COMPLAINT)) {
102                                        continue;
103                                }
104                                if (od == dep.officer) {
105                                        found = true;
106                                        break;
107                                }
108                        }
109                        if (!found || dep.officer == null) {
110                                data.remove(id);
111                                continue;
112                        }
113                        
114                        found = false;
115                        for (FleetMemberAPI curr : membersCopy) {
116                                if (curr == dep.member) {
117                                        found = true;
118                                        break;
119                                }
120                        }
121                        if (!found || dep.member == null) {
122                                data.remove(id);
123                                continue;
124                        }
125                        
126                        
127                        if (dep.seenWithOfficer != null) {
128                                float days = clock.getElapsedDaysSince(dep.seenWithOfficer);
129                                if (days >= MAX_DAYS_TO_KEEP_TRACK) {
130                                        dep.seenWithOfficer = null;
131                                        dep.seenWithoutOfficer = null;
132                                }
133                        }
134                        if (dep.seenWithoutOfficer != null) {
135                                float days = clock.getElapsedDaysSince(dep.seenWithoutOfficer);
136                                if (days >= MAX_DAYS_TO_KEEP_TRACK) {
137                                        dep.seenWithoutOfficer = null;
138                                }
139                        }
140                        
141                        if (dep.seenWithOfficer == null && dep.seenWithoutOfficer == null) {
142                                data.remove(id);
143                                continue;
144                        }
145                }
146                
147        }
148
149        @Override
150        public void appliedPostCombatCRLossToFleetMember(FleetMemberAPI member) {
151                applyFMStateToOfficerIfNecessary(member, true);
152        }
153        
154        public void applyFMStateToOfficerIfNecessary(FleetMemberAPI member, boolean wasDeployed) {
155                cleanUpOldData();
156                
157                OfficerDeployments dep = getDeploymentsData(member);
158                if (dep == null) return;
159                boolean withOfficer = dep.officer.getPerson() == member.getCaptain();
160                if (member.getCaptain() != null && member.getCaptain().isPlayer()) {
161                        return; // don't complain if they were replaced by player
162                }
163                
164                if (Misc.isMercenary(dep.officer.getPerson()) || dep.officer.getPerson().getAICoreId() != null) {
165                        return; // mercs and AI cores don't complain, though AI cores would not normally have an OfficerData anyway
166                }
167                
168                long ts = Global.getSector().getClock().getTimestamp();
169                
170                if (dep.member != member) {
171                        if (dep.member.getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal() <= member.getHullSpec().getHullSize().ordinal()) {
172                                dep.member = member;
173                                dep.resetTimes();
174                                if (wasDeployed) {
175                                        dep.seenWithOfficer = ts;
176                                }
177                                return;
178                        }
179                }
180                        
181                if (!withOfficer && wasDeployed) {
182                        dep.seenWithoutOfficer = ts;
183                }
184                
185                if (withOfficer && dep.seenWithOfficer != null && dep.seenWithoutOfficer != null && 
186                                dep.seenWithoutOfficer > dep.seenWithOfficer) {
187                        dep.officer.getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(HAS_REASSIGNMENT_COMPLAINT, true);
188                        dep.officer.getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(REASSIGNMENT_SHIP_NAME, dep.member.getShipName());
189                        data.remove(dep.officer.getPerson().getId());
190                        // failsafe for hotfix RC8; the above should work, but just in case
191                        Set<String> remove = new LinkedHashSet<>();
192                        for (String id : data.keySet()) {
193                                OfficerDeployments curr = data.get(id);
194                                if (curr != null && curr.member == member) {
195                                        remove.add(id);
196                                }
197                        }
198                        for (String id : remove) {
199                                data.remove(id);
200                        }
201                        return;
202                }
203                
204                if (withOfficer && (dep.seenWithOfficer == null || wasDeployed)) {
205                        dep.seenWithOfficer = ts;
206                }
207        }
208        
209        public OfficerDeployments getDeploymentsData(FleetMemberAPI member) {
210                OfficerDataAPI od = getOfficerData(member);
211                if (od != null) {
212                        if (od.getPerson().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(HAS_REASSIGNMENT_COMPLAINT)) {
213                                return null;
214                        }
215                        if (!Misc.combatPayEnabled(od.getPerson())) {
216                                return null;
217                        }
218                        OfficerDeployments dep = data.get(od.getPerson().getId());
219                        if (dep == null) {
220                                dep = new OfficerDeployments();
221                                dep.member = member;
222                                dep.officer = od;
223                                data.put(od.getPerson().getId(), dep);
224                        }
225                        return dep;
226                }
227                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
228                if (pf == null) return null;
229                
230                for (OfficerDeployments curr : data.values()) {
231                        if (curr.member == member) {
232                                return curr;
233                        }
234                }
235                return null;
236        }
237        
238        
239        public OfficerDataAPI getOfficerData(FleetMemberAPI member) {
240                if (member == null || member.getCaptain() == null) return null;
241                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
242                if (pf == null) return null;
243                for (OfficerDataAPI od : pf.getFleetData().getOfficersCopy()) {
244                        if (od.getPerson() == member.getCaptain()) {
245                                return od;
246                        }
247                }
248                return null;
249        }

251}
